usedFor: Each processed Applivery build is saved to a Dropbox folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Build Processed” in Applivery, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Processed means the build is ready, whereas “New Build Uploaded” fires before processing is done.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” pulls from a public web link, so the build must be reachable at one.
